records.text: Owens called the Libs of TikTok operator an Israel operative, while saying she was not Israeli, and accused her of flooding social media with stories about mothers killing children to create mass panic.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And of course, this is being echoed by libs of TikTok, another committed Israel-Israeli operative, I would almost say. She's not Israeli, but she's an Israel operative, no question. ... She's been flooding the zones with these stories and trying to create mass panic. She wrote this, Kaya (Libs of TikTok operator; full name and spelling unverified).

records.text: In the Libs of TikTok post read by Owens, Chaya Raichik said Tynisha Lashae Jones was arrested and charged in South Carolina with homicide after her infant daughter was found dead with lethal amounts of morphine in her system; the transcript’s name spelling is caveated.
